incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street in a town is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower levels of multi-story buildings. A stop sign is visible on the right.

observations.description: Brown, murky water covers the entire street, reaching up to the bases of buildings and submerging ground-level entrances.
Multi-story buildings with shops on the ground floor, some with arched or recessed entrances. A stop sign is visible on the right.
Signs above some windows and a street lamp post are visible but not legible. A small white object is floating on the water near the left building.

inconsistencies: The report mentions Nabeul, but the image shows a European-style town, not consistent with the report.
